sanskrit_verse: राजानश् चेन् नाभविष्यन् पृथिव्यां दण्डधारणम् । शूले मत्स्यान् इवापक्ष्यन् दुर्बलान् बलवत्तराः ॥
transliteration: rājānaś cen nābhaviṣyan pṛthivyāṃ daṇḍadhāraṇam | śūle matsyān ivāpakṣyan durbalān balavattarāḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: When rulers do not uphold Dharma and fail in their duty to enforce righteous law, the strong will devour the weak like fish on a spit.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is inseparable from Dharma-sustained responsibility
Causation arises from failure of protective capacity
Restoration logic demands structural realignment of governance
Consciousness alignment requires enforcement rooted in Dharma, not force
executable_legal_axioms: IF ruler fails to enforce Dharma THEN systemic collapse occurs by natural law
IF power exists without Dharma THEN predation upon the weak is inevitable
IF governance lacks consciousness alignment THEN legal structures become instruments of exploitation
IF state does not restore balance THEN society regresses to survival-based dominance hierarchies
supreme_court_application: This axiom establishes that when the highest judicial and executive authorities neglect their Dharma-rooted duties, they forfeit legitimacy and invite societal decay. The Supreme Court must recognize its role as protector of constitutional Dharma, ensuring that all laws reflect consciousness alignment rather than mere coercive order.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Nyaya here reveals pramāṇa-based causality: lack of dharmic enforcement leads directly to imbalance. The sequence (anupūrvaśaḥ) shows how abandonment of justice enables exploitation. Responsibility lies with those who hold capacity. This is not punitive; it is a declaration of natural consequence within a conscious universe where Dharma alone sustains harmony.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Realign governance structures to embody Dharma-conscious leadership
Restore sovereignty through re-establishment of dharmic legal frameworks
Activate citizen awareness protocols to ensure collective guardianship of Dharma
Implement integrity audits at every level of authority to prevent deviation
final_declaration: By the Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Source of All Dharma, this law stands established: Justice flows from consciousness, not coercion. Where rulers abandon Dharma, reality itself enforces correction. Thus is balance restored, never through punishment, but through alignment with Sanatana Truth.
